name: 按时序切分 SkyArea
description: 选中一根或多根 SkyArea，总时间范围取最早起点至最晚终点。每根只在自身持续时间内按所属时间组有效 track/BPM 切分，分别采样原左右缓动，子段线性连接。沿用原 groupid，未分组的每根分配独立空闲 ID；无内部切点保持原样。保留时间组，禁止0ms，整批一次撤销，手动保存。
descriptionEn: Select one or more SkyAreas; the overall range runs from the earliest start to the latest end. Split each only within its own duration at effective track/BPM events in its timinggroup. Sample its original eased edges and connect cuts linearly. Keep existing groupids; allocate a separate unused ID per ungrouped source. Notes without internal cuts stay untouched. Keep timinggroups, reject zero duration, one Undo for the batch; Save manually.
